note: The parser's two workflow-as-code detection paths, for the default entrypoint main. windmill-lite records them, and its build refuses such scripts (WA-33/c).

cases.title: the parsed path needs no task(

given.source: export const main = workflow(async (x: number) => x)

cases.title: the substring fallback does not run when a declaration gives main's parameters

given.source:
// workflow( and task( from windmill-client
export async function main() { return 1; }

cases.title: without a declaration of main, workflow(, task( and windmill-client anywhere select it

given.source:
// workflow( and task( from windmill-client
export const main = async () => 1;

cases.title: a parenthesised async function expression as first argument

given.source: export let main = workflow((async function (x: number) { return x; }));

cases.title: a callback that is not async, and a call through a member, are not the parsed path
an ambient declaration of main gives its parameters, so the parsed path does not run
cases.note: The build reads a declare function as a function declaration (open question in the PR).

given.source:
declare function main(x: number): number;
export const main = workflow(async (x: number) => x);

cases.title: the build refuses a script either detection path classifies as workflow-as-code
cases.note: A root path script classified by the parsed path and an inline flow step classified by the substring fallback both fail with unsupported_feature, unsupported: workflow_as_code (ADR 0001 §3); the plain step beside them builds.
